specials.title: Red Dog Bar & Bistro Piney Creek Specials
specials.description:
Appetizers:
Steamed Clams with White Wine, Garlic & Butter ... 16 Garlicky, buttery steamed clams with white wine, shallots, fresh parsley and lemon juice. Served with crusty bread for soaking up the juices!

Wedge Salad ... 12
A crisp quarter-head of iceberg lettuce topped with creamy blue cheese ranch dressing, crispy bacon, diced tomatoes, and blue cheese crumbles.

Entrées:
Linguine with Clams "in Bianco" (White Clam Sauce) ... 28
Linguine with in-shell clams, white wine, plenty of fresh garlic, lemon juice, and a hint of red pepper flakes.

Pho Ga Soup ... 20
Vietnamese chicken noodle soup with a deeply flavored homemade chicken broth, rice noodles and tons of chicken. Served with a delicious array of toppings that include, bean sprouts, cilantro, sliced jalapeños, lime wedge, spring onions and Thai basil all drizzled with Hoisin and Sriracha sauce. Unbelievably delicious.

Dessert:
Strawberry Shortcake ... 10
Flaky shortcake topped with sweetened strawberries and whipped cream. Just like Grandma used to make.

LUNCH SPECIAL- Friday & Saturday 11 AM-3 PM
Grilled Gyro ... 15
Seasoned ground lamb, lettuce, tomato, onion, feta and Tzatziki sauce, wrapped in a warm pita.
